name: gemm_cublas
goal: Port gemm.cu (cublasSgemm, column-major, C = 1.5*A*B - 0.5*C, M=384 N=320 K=256) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 calling oneMath (oneapi::math::blas::column_major::gemm, include <oneapi/math.hpp>, link -lonemath) with zero dpct helpers and no oneapi::mkl product-only API; the float32 output must match the double-accumulating C++ reference within atol 2e-3. Tolerance: inputs are in [-0.5, 0.5), so every entry of |A||B| is at most K/4 = 64; the standard bound for a K-term float32 dot product in ANY summation order (blocked, FMA, parallel) is gamma_K*(|A||B|)_ij with gamma_256 = 1.53e-5, times |alpha| = 1.5 gives 1.47e-3, plus a few ulp for the final alpha/beta update. 2e-3 therefore never rejects a correct SGEMM, while a transpose/leading-dimension/alpha/beta bug produces errors of order 1-10.
